description: Return one plain-Spanish sentence per indicator (USD retail and wholesale, reserves, interest rates, inflation, UVA) describing how it moved during a closed week, with direction and links, plus the permalink of that week's summary page. Use it for a quick "how did the Argentine economy do this week" overview; use get_series for exact values. Defaults to the last closed week (Monday to Sunday). Read-only, no side effects, no authentication. Rate limited to 60 calls per minute per IP. Data updates at most once per business day.

week_ending.description: Sunday that closes the week, as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the last closed week; any other date is anchored to the previous Sunday.

name: get_weekly_summary
title: Get the weekly economic summary
